article.story: SMITHFIELD, R.I. -- — Timofei Rudovskii had 20 points in Bryant's 69-52 win against NJIT on Saturday. Rudovskii added eight rebounds for the Bulldogs (9-20, 5-10 America East Conference). Keegan Harvey scored 16 points and added eight rebounds. Ty Tabales shot 5 of 12 from the field, including 2 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points, while adding four steals. Sebastian Robinson led the Highlanders (15-15, 10-5) in scoring, finishing with 15 points and four steals. Ari Fulton added 10 points for NJIT. David Bolden finished with nine points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
